title: Full-Time Operations & Recruiting VA (Scheduling, CRM, Email Outreach)
description:
2 Tone Wash is a fast-growing six-figure window and exterior cleaning company in Brooklyn, NY. We're hiring one sharp, self-starting assistant who is fluent in AI, fluent in English, and can SELL. You will run the busy work behind our hiring, then run our phones, quotes and scheduling in season. We approve, you execute, and you get paid for results.



NOV-FEB (off-season): RECRUITING, OUTREACH + RESEARCH

- Track every recruiting and outreach touch 
s, applications, interviews, follow-ups) so nothing slips.

- Build lists from public sources: campus clubs, advisors, career centers, NYC storefronts, property managers and commercial accounts. Every row has a source link.

- Run outreach with AI-assisted, scheduled messages and follow-ups so no message is ever forgotten. Texts only go to people who opted in.
s include an opt-out. Messages to students go out 9am-8pm New York time only.

- Research and report back with links: equipment, trailers, garage and storage units in Brooklyn, vans and wrap quotes. Read the fine print (price, power, access rules, lease terms, shipping, returns). Use AI to speed up, then fact-check against the original source.

- Send a daily report: done, next, needs our approval. Short 20-minute check-in call every day.

- Teach us. Record quick walkthroughs of the AI tools and workflows you build.



MAR-NOV (season): PHONES, QUOTES + SALES

- Manage the phone at all hours. If something happens, you answer and help.

- Answer calls and messages, quote from our price guide, book and schedule crews, and send confirmations. We get 5+ new leads a day.

- Pitch our seasonal plans over the phone and upsell jobs.

- Send certificates of insurance (COI) and handle paperwork for commercial accounts.

- Handle problems calmly and get them resolved.

- Build and maintain AI workflows for replies, reminders and follow-ups.

- Expect 60+ hour weeks.



SCHEDULE

- Off-season (Nov-Feb): 5am-10am and 5pm-8pm New York time (6pm-11pm and 6am-9am Philippine time), so you can sleep 7 hours.

- Season (Mar-Nov): phones covered at all hours, 60+ hours a week.



YOU ARE

- Very fluent in English, written and spoken, with real sales skills.

- Very comfortable with AI tools (ChatGPT/Claude, automations like Zapier or Make, a CRM) and able to show examples.

- A fast learner who picks up new systems quickly and wants the upside of bonuses.

- A self-starter who spots a gap and fixes it without being asked.

- Detail-oriented. We use a price guide. You use AI to coordinate, but you always check that everything is correct and approved before it goes out.

- Honest, reliable and calm under pressure.



PAY

- Off-season: $1,000/month, reviewed after 90 days.

- Season: base $1,200/month, plus bonuses.

- Bonuses for: recruiting, upselling jobs, solving problems, sending COI and special work, closing commercial accounts, and efficiency using AI.

- Off-season KPIs: messages sent, responses, connections made. Hitting baseline earns your base pay; exceeding it and closing commercial accounts earns bonuses.

- Bonus terms are provided in writing.



HOW WE WORK

- You never scrape private personal data or send mass automated DMs. Approved methods only.



TO APPLY (we read every answer)

Start your reply with the word "TONE". Then tell us:

1. A workflow you built with AI that saved real time, the tool you used, and how you checked accuracy.

2. Whether you can work the schedule above, including all-hours phone coverage in season.

3. A 2-minute voice recording pitching a seasonal window cleaning plan to a homeowner.

4. Links to any examples of your work.

Shortlisted applicants get a paid 2-hour test task.

title: Miro Board Designer + Canva Creative (Amazon FBA content)
description:
I am an Amazon FBA seller and coach. I explain everything visually, and I need one person whose main job is building my Miro boards, with quick Canva creatives on the side.



MAIN JOB: MIRO BOARDS (about eighty percent of your time)

- Turn my videos, live calls and voice notes into clean, well organized Miro boards (FBA, FBM, wholesale, online arbitrage, student results, step by step processes)

- Build a board for every live session I run, so I always have a visual process to show

- Research competitors' boards and frameworks, then build ours in the same style using my systems

- Design visually appealing framework pages and diagrams from my processes

- Keep a library of boards organized and reusable for videos and presentations



SIDE JOB: QUICK CREATIVES IN CANVA (about twenty percent)

- Story posts with a call to action: I send you a photo of me, the student result or the text to put on screen, and an example post I like, and you make a similar one, fast

- Simple image posts with text on screen, screenshots of results and keywords I give you

- Occasional slides, visual templates and cleaner layouts of existing boards



YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

- Are strong in Miro (show me boards you have built)

- Are comfortable in Canva and can match the look of an example I send you

- Have an eye for layout, hierarchy and clean design; Figma or Photoshop a plus

- Can watch a long video and pull out the structure without being told

- Have experience with Amazon FBA content, or are willing to learn the terms fast

- Write clear English, work fast and take feedback well

- Can work forty hours a week with some overlap with US Eastern time



PAY

$300 per month to start, full time, forty hours a week. This is starting pay. Strong creatives get raises.



HOW TO APPLY

Put the word MIRO at the top of your application and include links or screenshots of two Miro boards and one social post or story you designed. Applications without samples will not be read.

title: Corporate Attorney – Healthcare Legal Operations
description:
Company: OCD Anxiety Centers

Location: Remote – Philippines

IMPORTANT: Applicants must hold an active license to practice law in the Philippines and must be admitted to the Philippine Bar.





About US:

OCD Anxiety Centers is passionate about bringing help and hope to individuals and families affected by anxiety and related disorders. We are an evidence-based behavioral health organization committed to providing effective, research-supported treatments and maintaining high standards of clinical care.



We provide specialized, evidence-based treatment programs through our network of treatment centers and virtual care services. Our programs serve individuals and families across multiple states in the United States, including Utah, California, Texas, Arizona, Colorado, Maryland, Virginia, and Washington, as well as additional markets through virtual treatment services.







The Team You Will Work With

You will work remotely from the Philippines as part of our corporate support team, collaborating directly with U.S.-based leadership and departments, including Human Resources, Operations, Clinical, Billing, and Compliance.



This position supports the company's corporate legal and operational needs across its multiple U.S. locations and business entities.



You will assist with contract management, corporate legal matters, healthcare documentation, HIPAA compliance, employment-law research, and other legal support functions that help keep our business operations organized, compliant, and running efficiently.



You will work closely with company leadership and appropriately licensed U.S. legal counsel, providing research, documentation, contract review, and compliance support to help address the legal and operational needs of a growing multi-state healthcare organization.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, communicate effectively with U.S.-based teams, manage confidential information responsibly, and contribute to a collaborative and accountable remote working environment.







Required Qualifications



- Active Philippine Bar membership and license to practice law in the Philippines (MANDATORY).

- Law degree and admission to the Philippine Bar.

- Strong knowledge of contract law and demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, and analyzing contracts.

- Advanced proficiency using AI tools for contract review, including prompt design, clause comparison, iterative refinement, and independent verification of AI-generated results.

- Hands-on healthcare experience handling medical records and submitting records to healthcare payers.

- Practical experience applying HIPAA privacy and security requirements when handling protected health information.

- Experience supporting U.S. HR and employment-law matters, particularly California employment law.

- Willingness to learn and develop knowledge of employment requirements across multiple U.S. states.

- Excellent legal research, writing, drafting, and analytical skills.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate with a remote U.S.-based team.





Preferred Qualifications



- Five or more years of legal experience.

- Experience supporting U.S.-based companies, corporate legal departments, or international legal teams.

- Experience in healthcare or behavioral health organizations.

- Experience supporting companies operating across multiple U.S. states.

- Experience developing legal playbooks, employment-law references, and standardized legal operations processes.





Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

- Complete contract reviews, legal research, and document preparation accurately and within agreed timelines.

- Produce clear contract-review summaries with AI-generated findings verified against source agreements and reliable legal resources.

- Prepare and submit approved medical records to payers within applicable deadlines.

- Follow HIPAA and company privacy and security procedures.

- Provide timely and accurate California employment-law research and maintain updated references for the company's 10 operating states as assigned.

- Keep legal trackers, contracts, templates, and medical-record request logs organized and up to date.

- Identify and promptly escalate legal, employment, privacy, and compliance concerns.

- Provide timely status updates and complete follow-up actions with internal teams and outside counsel.



Performance Growth



As performance goals are consistently achieved, the supervisor will review progress and establish additional goals to support professional growth, improve contract-review processes, strengthen medical-record workflows, expand employment-law knowledge, and meet the company's evolving legal support needs.





Scope of the Role

This is an offshore paralegal and legal support position based in the Philippines. The role provides legal research, documentation, contract support, medical-record coordination, and compliance support to the company's U.S. operations.



Matters requiring U.S. legal advice or representation will be referred to appropriately licensed U.S. counsel and handled in accordance with applicable licensing requirements.

title: Payroll/ Finance Operations Accountant

This role makes sure Ceterus gets everything it needs, cleanly and on time, and owns what Ceterus does not: bi-weekly payroll in ADP, vendor accounts and timely payment, the working-capital KPIs (DIO, DSO, DPO, CCC), and the weekly and monthly report-outs that drive action. You will be the single point of contact for Ceterus, resolving their open items and blockers so the P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet are complete and holistic every month. The business has roughly 13 employees today; this role grows with us to 30+.

Key responsibilities

Bi-weekly payroll (ADP) – primary

• Run end-to-end bi-weekly payroll in ADP for all employees, on time and without error.

• Pull and reconcile hours, class and session counts, and commissions from Mindbody, the studio hours-tracking tool, and other systems before each run.

• Maintain employee records, tax setup, PTO, and new-hire/termination processing in ADP; support quarterly filings and year-end W-2/1099 processing.

• Deliver payroll registers and journal detail to Ceterus each pay period.

Ceterus hand-off and blocker resolution

• Capture every business receipt and expense (credit cards, reimbursements, vendor bills, subscriptions, cash) and transmit them to Ceterus, coded and documented, on their cadence.

• Own the Ceterus open-items list: answer questions, chase missing documentation, and clear blockers within two business days so the close is never held up.

• Reconcile Mindbody sales, merchant settlements, and bank activity weekly and flag variances to Ceterus before month-end.

• Deliver a complete, organized month-end package so Ceterus can produce a holistic P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet.

Vendor accounts and accounts payable

• Own all vendor accounts for goods and services: setup, W-9s, contact and terms records, portal logins, and account reconciliations.

• Collect, verify, and route vendor invoices for approval; schedule and release payments so every vendor is paid on time and to agreed terms, with no late fees or service interruptions.

• Maintain an AP aging and a weekly payment calendar; resolve vendor disputes and statement discrepancies promptly.

• Provide Ceterus with the complete, coded AP record each period.

KPIs and reporting – primary

• Build and maintain DIO, DSO, DPO, and CCC, including the definitions and data sources behind each.

• Identify what drives each metric and execute actions to improve them.

• Produce the weekly and monthly report-outs described below, going beyond the standard Ceterus financial package.

Administrative support

• Support ownership and the Studio Manager with other administrative tasks as needed (insurance, licenses, vendor contracts, benefits paperwork, franchisor reporting).

Reporting cadence

• Weekly (Monday): one-page cash and working-capital snapshot – cash position, DIO/DSO/DPO/CCC vs. prior week and target, top exceptions, and owner-assigned action items with due dates.

• Monthly (within 5 business days of Ceterus close): KPI trends (rolling 12 months), root-cause commentary, 13-week cash forecast, status of last month's actions, and defined actions for the month ahead.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting (or Finance with accounting coursework) and working knowledge of U.S. GAAP.

• 3+ years of accounting experience, including time at a public accounting or outsourced accounting firm.

• Hands-on ADP payroll experience (Run or Workforce Now), including tax setup and year-end processing.

• Experience pulling and reconciling reports from Mindbody or a comparable membership/POS platform.

• Fluent in DIO, DSO, DPO, and CCC: can calculate them, explain the drivers, and show actions you have taken to improve them.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets; clear written and verbal communication with non-financial owners.

• Authorized to work in the U.S.; able to pass a background and credit check.

Preferred

• CPA, CPA candidate, or CMA; experience working alongside an outsourced bookkeeping firm.

• Fitness, wellness, or franchise experience with recurring membership billing; QuickBooks Online familiarity.

Who you are

• Integrity first. You handle payroll, banking access, and employee data and act accordingly.

• Independent. You set your own calendar, hit your deadlines, and tell ownership what you need.

• An owner. You treat company cash as your own, catch problems early, and follow issues to resolution.

• Organized and professional. Your files and hand-offs are clean enough for Ceterus or anyone else to pick up without questions.

• Flexible. In a small company you will help outside accounting when needed, and you are glad to.

Compensation

Competitive salary commensurate with experience (range: 8.5/hr), As headcount passes 30, this role is expected to grow

Send your resume and a short note to describing one cash-cycle improvement you personally drove and its result.

title: Content Execution Assistant — Remote, Independent Contractor
description:
Read this first

We create and publish content every day across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok,
, and LinkedIn.

We're looking for someone who gets things done quickly, takes initiative, and can handle a high volume of work without sacrificing quality.

This is not a role where you'll spend most of your time organizing folders, updating spreadsheets, or planning workflows. We need someone who executes.

If you're the type of person who sees what needs to be done, gets started, and finishes without constant reminders, keep reading.

Your 3 Main Responsibilities

1. Test Content at Volume Without Sacrificing Quality (Primary Focus)

Our biggest priority is testing more content, faster, to identify what performs best.

You'll help us:

Use AI tools and existing workflows to generate and test different content ideas, hooks, formats, and variations.

Work with our editors to turn ideas and AI-generated material into finished content.

Keep a high volume of content moving through production, review, approval, and publishing.

Review outputs for accuracy, quality, and brand fit.

Request revisions when needed and follow through until they're completed.

Help identify winning content and test more variations of what works.

Ensure content is published on time and never goes live without required approval.

The goal is simple: test more content, learn faster, and consistently get high-quality content published.

2. Actively Engage With Other Posts and Creators

We don't want our social accounts to feel like automated publishing machines.

You'll help keep our accounts active, authentic, and connected to the communities we're trying to reach.

This includes:

Regularly engaging with relevant posts, creators, and accounts in our niche.

Leaving thoughtful, genuine comments that contribute to conversations.

Responding to comments and interactions on our own content.

Identifying opportunities to build relationships with other creators.

Keeping our social presence active beyond simply posting content.

The goal is to make our accounts feel like real people are behind them, not just a content scheduler.

3. Handle Whatever Else Needs to Get Done

We're a fast-moving team, and priorities can change throughout the week.

You'll be expected to jump in and help with tasks as they come up, whether that's preparing content, following up with an editor, researching something, updating a page, or handling an unexpected project.

What matters is that you:

Take ownership of assigned tasks.

Move quickly without needing constant follow-up.

Communicate when something is completed or blocked.

Adapt when priorities change.

Deliver work on time.

We value someone who figures things out and gets things done over someone who needs detailed instructions for every step.

What We Expect

Speed and execution: You consistently complete a high volume of tasks.

Quality at speed: You move fast, but don't publish sloppy or unapproved work.

Initiative: You take action and solve problems instead of waiting to be told every next step.

Responsiveness: You communicate promptly and don't leave tasks hanging.

Adaptability: You're comfortable switching between content, engagement, and other priorities.

AI fluency: You're comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude,  and other AI tools to work faster and produce better results.

Strong English: You can write clearly and engage naturally with people online.

How We Work

We move fast, and we expect the same from you.

Messages should be acknowledged within 2 hours during agreed business-hour overlap.

Content should be reviewed and moved forward within 4 hours of entering your queue.

Blockers should be communicated as soon as they arise.

Scheduled content should be ready at least 24 hours before publishing whenever possible.

Nothing gets published without the required approval.

We care more about completed, high-quality work than how much time you spend planning or organizing it.

The Arrangement

Location: Remote — Philippines preferred

Type: Independent contractor. This is not employment and no employment benefits are provided

Workload: Target of 40 hours per week, with substantial overlap with our business hours

Compensation: Agreed monthly contract rate

Equipment: Your own computer and reliable internet. Cameras are required to be on during company and team meetings.

Opportunity: Ongoing role with room to grow as our content operation expands

How to Apply

Keep it short. Tell us:

Your experience creating, managing, or publishing content at volume.

Which AI tools you've used and how you've used them to get work done faster.

Your experience engaging with audiences or other creators on social media.

Your availability and expected monthly rate.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid test task so we can see how you work.

We're looking for a doer — someone who can help us test more content, build authentic engagement, and keep things moving every single day.

title: Trade Data & Documentation Specialist (EUDR supplier data)
description:
TYPE OF EMPLOYMENT

Part-time, 20 hours/week (growth to full-time possible)



HOURS

Flexible, with at least 3 hours overlap with the Netherlands each working day:

4:00 PM – 7:00 PM Philippine time (winter), 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM (summer).



ABOUT US

Claeritas is a Dutch customs operations and trade compliance company. We help

European importers with their recurring customs and compliance work. We prepare

the work; our clients review and submit it themselves.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You start on our Border-Ready Data Desk. European importers of coffee, cocoa,

palm oil, rubber, soy and wood must collect proof from their suppliers under the

EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR). You make sure that data comes in, is complete

and is correct. Later you also check shipping documents for our customs clients.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Contact our clients' suppliers by
, phone and WhatsApp, in English

- Request and follow up geolocation data, production dates and legality documents

- Check received data against our checklist and flag what is missing or inconsistent

- Ask the supplier to correct data – never correct it yourself

- Prepare draft due diligence statements for our clients to review

- Keep the tracker and case files updated every day

- Write a short weekly status report per client

- Log your time per client and per task



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least 3 years in import/export documentation, freight forwarding, customs

  brokerage or supplier compliance

- You know invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and certificates of origin,

  and you notice when they do not match

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Persistent and polite: you follow up without being reminded

- Accurate in Excel or Google Sheets

- Stable internet, a quiet workspace, your own laptop

- Discretion with confidential client data



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with EUDR, sustainability certification or supplier audits

- Basic GIS: opening a GeoJSON file and checking a location on a map

- Knowledge of HS codes or EU customs

- Licensed Customs Broker, or a degree in customs administration, logistics or

  supply chain



HOW WE WORK

- You work from a written briefing and checklist; every result is checked by a

  second person before it goes to the client

- You use personal accounts only; no shared logins, no client data in personal

- You never submit documents to authorities and never give legal conclusions

- Independent contractor agreement with confidentiality and data protection terms



SELECTION AND START

1. Send your CV and a short note (max. 150 words): which trade documents have you

   worked with, and tell us about one file you completed despite missing information

2. Audio voice call

3. Paid test task of about 3 hours

4. Expected start: December 2026/ Januari 2027, when our first client for this work

   starts. We tell you honestly where we are in that process.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the words "SUPPLIER DATA". Applications without these

words will not be read.

title: Project Manager & Executive Assistant
description:
We build direct-to-consumer brands in health and wellness. Thousands of ads tested. Tens of thousands of orders shipped.



We're hiring one person for two jobs: project manager for our team, and executive assistant to our founder.



You'll keep our projects moving and take work off the founder's plate. Both come down to the same thing: nothing falls through the cracks.





AS PROJECT MANAGER



• Run our creative projects. Follow up with video editors so every ad ships on time, and make sure they have the footage, briefs and credits they need.

• Manage our creators and actors. Reach out, send briefs and contracts, track what's been delivered, and check it against the brief.

• Run other projects as they come up. Keep the owners, deadlines and next steps clear from start to finish.





AS EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT



• Handle what the founder hands you. Research, documents, follow-ups and whatever else comes up that week.

• Help us hire. Write and post job ads, screen applicants against clear criteria, and research people we should talk to.

• Keep our tools running. Accounts, credits and setup on our software and AI platforms.

• Flag what matters. If you come across something important, the founder hears about it from you.

• Send a short report every day. What's done, what's stuck, what you need.





WE'RE PROBABLY A FIT IF...



• You have 2+ years as an executive assistant, project manager or production coordinator.

• You can go from chasing a project deadline to a one-off task from the founder without losing track of either.

• You finish what you start, and nobody has to chase you.

• When you hit something you've never done, you figure it out before you ask.

• You tell people early when a deadline is at risk, including your boss.

• You keep private information private.

• Your written and spoken English is clear. You'll be
ing American actors every week.

• You use AI in your everyday work, and you check what it gives you.





IT'S NOT FOR YOU IF...



• You only want one kind of work.

• You need step-by-step instructions for everything.

• You wait to be told what's next.

• You don't like following up with people.





If you've read this far, the keyword is "Close the Loop". The application form will ask for it.





PAY AND HOURS



• $1,000 USD a month, fixed, plus a quarterly performance bonus of up to $200.

• 30 hours a week: Monday to Friday, 9 AM–3 PM Manila time. During those hours, you reply within 20 minutes. Outside them, your time is yours.

• Fully remote, starting with a 2-week paid trial.

• As the team grows, this seat can grow into full-time and a bigger role. You earn it. We don't promise it.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through this form (about 10 minutes): 



Have these ready:



1. A 2-minute Loom, camera on, made for this job. Say the job title, who you are and why you want this job. Then share your screen and show us proof that you're responsible and detail-oriented. Anything real counts: a project tracker, an SOP you wrote, a report, a spreadsheet, a system you built. Blur anything private.

2. Short answers to four questions, in your own words.





WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. A short paid test (45 minutes, $15).

2. A 20-minute call.

3. We speak with two of your past bosses.

4. A 2-week paid trial.

title: Credit Repair Operations Manager / Executive Assistant
description:
Hustle Lyfe Financial is hiring an experienced virtual assistant based in the Philippines to manage the daily operations of our credit repair business.



We are looking for someone who already knows how to review credit reports, prepare disputes, communicate with clients, and keep accounts moving forward. You should be organized, dependable, and capable of handling routine operations independently with minimal supervision.



You will work directly with the owner through a weekly Zoom meeting and brief updates through WhatsApp. Initial onboarding will cover our processes, services, and expectations.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Manage client onboarding, collect required documents, and maintain complete client files.



• Review Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion credit reports for potentially inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable information.



• Prepare individualized, factual disputes using Credit Repair Cloud and supporting client documentation.



• Track dispute rounds, responses, deadlines, and follow up tasks.



• Keep Credit Repair Cloud and GoHighLevel records accurate and current.



• Manage client conversations, appointments, reminders, and follow ups through GoHighLevel.



• Answer client questions professionally through phone,
, and text.



• Proactively address missing documents, stalled accounts, and routine service issues.



• Escalate sensitive matters, refund requests, legal complaints, and decisions requiring owner approval.



• Attend a weekly Zoom meeting and communicate brief updates or urgent concerns through WhatsApp.



• Submit a weekly summary of completed work, account progress, outstanding issues, and upcoming priorities.



• Maintain documented procedures and recommend improvements to daily operations.



• Protect confidential client information and follow approved security procedures.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Previous hands on experience working for a U.S. credit repair business.



• Practical experience using Credit Repair Cloud and GoHighLevel. You must be comfortable working in both platforms without basic software training.



• Ability to use Zoom for meetings and WhatsApp for internal communication.



• Strong understanding of credit reports, dispute preparation, and account follow ups.



• Excellent written and spoken English.



• Strong customer service, organization, and time management skills.



• Ability to take ownership of routine operations without constant reminders.



• Reliable computer, stable internet connection, headset, and private workspace.

WORKING EXPECTATIONS



We want someone who can become the primary operator of our daily credit repair workflow. You should manage your workload, communicate proactively, and recognize when a matter requires owner approval.

title: Creative Strategist for a Beauty & Supplement E-Commerce
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Creative Strategist with a strong background in DTC/e-commerce, especially within beauty, skincare, and supplement brands.



This is a performance-focused role. We’re not only looking for someone who can create good-looking ads, but we want someone who understands what makes creatives spend, scale, and generate profitable ROAS.



What You’ll Do

- Develop fresh creative concepts and angles for our beauty and supplement products.

- Create video and static ad concepts for Meta.

- Write hooks, scripts, headlines, ad copy, and detailed creative briefs.

- Research competitors, customer reviews, trends, winning ads, and new opportunities.

- Develop concepts for different personas and stages of awareness.

- Analyze Spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and other creative performance metrics.

- Identify winning creatives and develop iterations to help them scale.

- Work closely with our media buyers, editors, and designers.

- Ensure ad messaging and creative angles align with our landing/product pages.

- Understand how to communicate beauty and supplement benefits while keeping claims appropriate.



Who We’re Looking For

You must have previous experience as a Creative Strategist for DTC/e-commerce brands.



Experience with beauty/skincare and supplements is highly preferred.



You should understand:

- Meta/Facebook advertising

- Direct-response creative strategy

- UGC and static advertising

- Creative testing and iteration

- Customer psychology and market awareness

- Performance metrics, particularly spend and ROAS



⚠️ IMPORTANT: PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENT



Please do not apply without providing proof of previous creative performance.



Before we consider an application, you MUST attach a portfolio containing examples of ads/creatives you personally strategized.



For each relevant creative, please provide:

AD/CREATIVE

→ Your involvement/role

→ Total Ad Spend

→ ROAS

→ Other relevant results (CPA, CTR, purchases, etc., if available)

→ Proof of performance (screenshots from Meta Ads Manager or another verifiable source)



The Spend metric is especially important to us.



We want to see creatives that didn't simply achieve a strong ROAS on a small test budget; we want to understand how much spend the creative was able to handle while maintaining performance.



Applications that provide creative examples without Spend +, ROAS +, or supporting proof may not be considered.



Let us also know your hourly rate.

title: Project Coordinator | Work From Home | Philippines | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
We’re looking for an organized, proactive project coordinator based in the Philippines to help us plan projects, coordinate people, and keep work moving.



You’ll be joining a fantastic, well-established Philippine-based team supporting Mr. Supply Chain, LLC, an education and advisory business led by Daniel Stanton. Everyone works from home. We value clear communication, dependable follow-through, curiosity, and helping each other succeed.



Who you’ll be working with



Daniel Stanton, known as Mr. Supply Chain®, is a globally recognized supply chain expert, educator, and author of Supply Chain Management For Dummies and Project Management with AI For Dummies. His LinkedIn Learning courses have reached millions of learners around the world.



Our work connects supply chain management, project leadership, and technology. Supply chain projects often involve IT; robotics and automation; manufacturing, material handling, and packaging equipment; business process transformation; and collaboration with customers and suppliers.



We’re leaning into AI in all aspects of our business, including how we plan, coordinate, and deliver projects. This is an opportunity to work at the cutting edge of project management practices, applying AI to real work and helping us develop better ways of getting things done.



About the opportunity



This recruitment is exploratory. We have not yet signed the client contract that would support this initial assignment, but there is a high likelihood that it will move forward. We’re meeting strong candidates now so we can be ready when the agreement is finalized.



We’re looking for someone who can grow with our team over the long term. You’ll initially help us establish an effective project coordination process, then apply and improve that process across future projects. The start date and weekly hours will depend on the final agreement and workload.



What you’ll do



You’ll work closely with Daniel and our team to keep plans current, information organized, and commitments moving forward. Responsibilities will include:



► Building and maintaining project schedules, task lists, milestones, and dependencies in Smartsheet.

► Coordinating meetings, preparing agendas, documenting decisions, and following up on action items.

► Tracking progress, risks, issues, changes, and outstanding information.

► Preparing clear status reports and dashboards.

► Organizing project files and maintaining accurate documentation.

► Following up respectfully and persistently with people responsible for deliverables.

► Developing reusable templates, checklists, and procedures for future projects.

► Using AI to support planning, analysis, documentation, and communication while checking outputs for accuracy.

► Helping us identify and implement useful workflow automations.



You don’t need to be the technical expert on every project. You do need to ask good questions, understand who is responsible for what, and make sure important details don’t fall through the cracks.



What we’re looking for



► Practical Smartsheet experience, including schedules, dependencies, reports, dashboards, and automated reminders. Please describe what you have actually built or maintained.

► Experience coordinating projects with multiple stakeholders and deadlines.

► Strong written and spoken English.

► Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

► Confidence asking questions, identifying gaps, and flagging problems early.

► An interest in building repeatable processes and improving how work gets done.

► Hands-on experience with AI tools and a willingness to keep learning and experimenting.

► Comfort using Google Workspace and video meetings.

► Reliable internet and a suitable work-from-home setup.

► Availability for some scheduled overlap with North American business hours.



A bachelor’s degree is preferred. Experience supporting client projects, working with a remote team, or coordinating supply chain, operations, or technology initiatives would be helpful.



Why join us?



You’ll become part of an established remote team with supportive colleagues and meaningful work. You’ll work directly with an experienced supply chain and project management educator, take ownership of project coordination, and help build processes we can use as the business grows.



You’ll also help put emerging AI-enabled project management practices into action. We want someone who brings ideas, exercises good judgment, and enjoys finding better ways to work.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-term member of the team.



How to apply



Please include:



A brief introduction and an explanation of why this opportunity interests you.



Your résumé, including your education and relevant project experience.



Specific examples of your Smartsheet work. Screenshots or anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential client information.



An example of how you’ve used AI to improve your work, including how you checked the results.



Your availability, preferred weekly hours, and earliest start date.



Your expected hourly rate in USD.



A short example of a time you identified a project problem and helped resolve it.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to an interview and a small paid Smartsheet skills exercise.

Success Metrics (KPIs)

title: Creative strategist and media buyer for ecom store Scaling
description:
# Creative Strategist & Media Buyer for Scaling a Winning eCommerce / Dropshipping Store



**We are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist and Performance Media Buyer who knows how to scale winning eCommerce products profitably through Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Snapchat Ads, and/or Pinterest Ads.**



We already have a Shopify dropshipping store generating approximately **$250 in revenue per day**, with 2–3 proven winning ads.



We are NOT starting from zero. We already have a working product, initial sales traction, and winning creatives. Now we want to scale the business significantly while maintaining healthy profit margins.



**Our scaling goals (daily revenue):**

- Phase 1: $250 → $1,000/day

- Phase 2: $1,000 → $3,000/day

- Phase 3: $3,000 → $10,000+/day



Our goal is to reach these revenue milestones **profitably**, not just generate revenue at any cost.



We need someone who has previously scaled successful eCommerce or dropshipping brands and understands how to turn a few winning ads into a consistent, profitable, scalable advertising system.



**We are not looking for someone who simply launches ads and hopes for results. We need a strategic thinker who understands WHY ads work, HOW to create more winning ads, WHEN to scale, and HOW to maintain profitability while increasing ad spend.**



## 1. Creative Strategy & Winning Ad Development



This is one of the most important parts of this role.



We currently have 2–3 winning ads and need someone who can use these as a starting point to build a repeatable creative testing and scaling system.



You must understand how to:



- Analyze winning ads and identify exactly why they work.

- Research customers, competitors, pain points, and buying motivations.

- Discover new winning hooks, angles, concepts, and messaging.

- Develop creative variations based on existing winners.

- Create completely new advertising concepts.

- Write direct-response video ad scripts.

- Develop UGC, product demonstration, storytelling, comparison, testimonial, and problem-solution ads.

- Create compelling hooks that stop people scrolling.

- Test different hooks, CTAs, offers, formats, and messaging.

- Find new winning advertising angles consistently.

- Create detailed briefs for video editors and UGC creators.

- Identify creative fatigue and replace declining ads.

- Build and manage a structured creative testing pipeline.

- Analyze creative performance and improve based on data.

- Build a library of winning creative concepts.

- Understand customer psychology and what drives purchases.



**We especially value someone who can take one winning ad, understand the psychology behind it, and develop 10–20 intelligent new creative concepts to test.**



We do not want random variations. We want strategic, research-driven creative testing.



## 2. Media Buying & Profitable Scaling



You must have previous experience managing and scaling eCommerce advertising campaigns.



We are interested in expertise across:



- Meta Ads 
 & Instagram)

- TikTok Ads

- Snapchat Ads

- Pinterest Ads



**You do not need to master all four platforms. Strong expertise and proven results on one or two platforms is more important.**



Your responsibilities include:



- Auditing existing advertising campaigns.

- Analyzing current winners and identifying growth opportunities.

- Building effective campaign structures.

- Creating and managing advertising campaigns.

- Developing strategies for increasing ad spend profitably.

- Managing daily advertising budgets.

- Testing new creatives, audiences, and offers.

- Understanding broad targeting and platform algorithms.

- Implementing vertical and horizontal scaling strategies where appropriate.

- Optimizing campaigns based on ROAS, CPA, and profitability.

- Identifying when to scale, pause, or adjust campaigns.

- Reducing wasted advertising spend.

- Monitoring performance and creative fatigue.

- Troubleshooting declining campaign performance.

- Developing a repeatable scaling framework.

- Testing additional advertising platforms when financially justified.



**We care about profitable scaling, not simply spending more money on ads.**



## 3. Advanced Creative Testing & Research



We need someone capable of continuously finding new winning ads.



Required skills include:



- Creative angle research

- Competitor advertising research

- Meta Ad Library research

- TikTok Creative Center research

- Customer pain-point research

- Hook development and testing

- Video ad scripting

- UGC creative strategy

- Static image ad strategy

- Product demonstration concepts

- Direct-response copywriting

- Creative iteration

- New creative concept development

- Audience awareness and buying psychology

- Creative performance analysis

- CTR and CPC analysis

- CPA and ROAS analysis

- Creative fatigue monitoring

- Testing prioritization

- Creative brief creation

- Working with video editors and content creators



You must understand the difference between improving existing winning ads and developing entirely new winning creative concepts.



We need both.



## 4. Scaling From $250 to $10,000+ Daily Revenue



We are looking for someone who can develop and execute a realistic scaling plan.



**Stage 1: $250 → $1,000 Daily Revenue**

- Audit existing ads, campaigns, and funnel performance.

- Identify immediate scaling opportunities.

- Analyze the 2–3 existing winning ads.

- Create new variations and test fresh creative angles.

- Improve media buying efficiency.

- Increase ad spend carefully when profitable.

- Establish a reliable creative testing process.

- Track contribution margin and profitability.



**Stage 2: $1,000 → $3,000 Daily Revenue**

- Increase creative testing volume.

- Find additional winning ads and angles.

- Scale profitable advertising campaigns.

- Expand into new audiences or platforms when appropriate.

- Reduce dependence on individual winning ads.

- Improve reporting, tracking, and campaign efficiency.

- Maintain sustainable profitability.



**Stage 3: $3,000 → $10,000+ Daily Revenue**

- Develop a more advanced advertising system.

- Maintain a consistent pipeline of winning creative concepts.

- Scale budgets with disciplined profitability controls.

- Expand successful campaigns and advertising channels.

- Coordinate ongoing creative production.

- Build reliable performance reporting.

- Identify new opportunities for sustainable growth.

- Maintain healthy margins while growing revenue.



These milestones are our targets, not guaranteed outcomes. We value realistic strategies based on actual performance data.



## 5. Analytics, Reporting & Profitability



You must understand the numbers behind successful eCommerce advertising.



Important metrics include:



- Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

- Break-even ROAS

- Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)

- Cost Per Purchase (CPA)

- Cost Per Click (CPC)

- Click-Through Rate (CTR)

- Cost Per Mille (CPM)

- Conversion Rate (CVR)

- Average Order Value (AOV)

- Contribution Margin

- Net Profit

- Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER)

- Revenue Per Visitor

- Ad Frequency

- Creative Fatigue

- Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)

- Attribution and Tracking Accuracy



You should know how to calculate break-even ROAS and identify whether scaling decisions make financial sense.



**Revenue growth only matters if we can protect profitability.**



## 6. eCommerce & Dropshipping Experience



Previous Shopify and dropshipping experience is highly preferred.



You should understand:



- Shopify stores and conversion funnels.

- Dropshipping product scaling.

- Winning product identification.

- Product-market fit.

- Customer buying psychology.

- Direct-response marketing.

- Offer creation and testing.

- Landing page optimization.

- Average order value optimization.

- Upsells and bundles.

- Conversion rate optimization.

- Product costs and margins.

- Shipping and fulfillment considerations.

- Refund rates and chargebacks.

- Advertising profitability.

- The differences between short-term wins and sustainable growth.



## 7. Tools & Platforms



Experience with these tools is a plus:



**Advertising Platforms**

- Meta Ads Manager

- TikTok Ads Manager

- Snapchat Ads Manager

- Pinterest Ads Manager



**Creative Research**

- Meta Ad Library

- TikTok Creative Center

- Foreplay

- Minea

- PiPiADS

- AdSpy

- Motion



**Analytics & Tracking**

- Shopify Analytics

- Google Analytics 4

- Triple Whale

- Northbeam

- Hyros

- Meta Pixel

- Conversions API

- TikTok Pixel



**Creative Production**

- CapCut

- Adobe Premiere Pro

- Canva

- Figma

- Google Sheets

- Notion

- ClickUp



You do not need experience with every tool, but must be comfortable analyzing campaigns, researching creatives, and making data-driven decisions.



## 8. What We Expect From You



We want someone who is proactive, analytical, experienced, and capable of working independently.



You should be able to:



- Analyze our winning ads and explain WHY they work.

- Identify immediate opportunities to improve performance.

- Create an actionable scaling strategy.

- Consistently generate new creative ideas.

- Write detailed briefs for video editors.

- Develop a reliable creative testing system.

- Manage advertising campaigns intelligently.

- Scale winners while controlling financial risk.

- Diagnose declining performance.

- Monitor profitability.

- Communicate results clearly.

- Provide weekly reports and action plans.

- Take ownership of your responsibilities.



**We do not want someone who needs to be told what to test every day.**



We want someone who proactively identifies opportunities and brings new strategies to the table.



## 9. Required Experience



**MUST HAVE:**

- Proven eCommerce or dropshipping advertising experience.

- Previous success scaling advertising campaigns.

- Strong creative strategy skills.

- Understanding of winning ad development.

- Experience with Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, or Pinterest Ads.

- Strong data analysis abilities.

- Knowledge of profitability and ROAS.

- Ability to work independently.

- Excellent communication.

- Verifiable previous results.



**BIG PLUS:**

- Experience scaling stores from $250/day to $1,000+/day in revenue.

- Experience scaling eCommerce brands to $3,000–$10,000+ daily revenue.

- Experience managing substantial advertising budgets.

- Experience building creative testing systems.

- Experience working with UGC creators and video editors.

- Experience across multiple advertising platforms.

- Advanced direct-response advertising knowledge.

- Experience with landing page CRO and offer optimization.



## 10. How We Measure Success



We evaluate performance based on:



- Daily revenue growth.

- Profitability and contribution margin.

- Number of new winning creatives discovered.

- Ability to increase profitable advertising spend.

- Campaign ROAS and CPA.

- Creative testing efficiency.

- Consistency of results.

- Quality of strategic decisions.

- Progress toward $1,000, $3,000, and $10,000+ daily revenue.



## 11. Application Requirements — IMPORTANT



**We only want applicants with real previous experience and proven results.**



Please answer these questions:



1. How many years of experience do you have in eCommerce media buying and creative strategy?

2. Which advertising platforms are you strongest in?

3. What is the largest eCommerce store you have personally helped scale?

4. What was the daily revenue before and after your involvement?

5. What was the largest daily ad budget you personally managed?

6. Have you scaled a Shopify or dropshipping store from $200–$500/day to $1,000+/day in revenue? Explain how.

7. **If I gave you 3 winning ads, how would you turn them into 10–20 new creative concepts?**

8. How do you identify WHY a specific creative is winning?

9. What would your strategy be to scale a store from $250 to $1,000/day in revenue while staying profitable?

10. What do you do when a winning ad starts declining?

11. How do you organize creative testing and communicate with video editors?

12. Which advertising, analytics, and creative research tools do you use?

13. Can you provide screenshots, case studies, or evidence of previous results, explaining your personal contribution?

14. What is your expected monthly salary or preferred compensation model?

15. Are you available for part-time or full-time work?



**Applications without relevant experience or proof of previous results will not be prioritized.**



## Final Note



We have an existing Shopify dropshipping store generating approximately **$250 per day in revenue**, with 2–3 winning advertisements.



Now we want to grow toward:



**$1,000/day → $3,000/day → $10,000+/day in revenue, while remaining profitable.**



We are looking for an experienced long-term team member who understands both creative strategy and performance advertising.



We don't need someone who simply launches campaigns.



We need someone who understands why advertising works, how to develop more winning creatives, and how to scale successful products responsibly.



**If you have previously scaled successful eCommerce businesses and can prove your results, we want to hear from you.**

title: Ebook Writer & Designer (Women's Health / Period Bloat) – Canva + Research
description:
I run Lenire, a new Dutch supplement brand for women who get bloated and get cramps around their period. I'm looking for one person who can research, write and design ebooks and guides that we give away as lead magnets and send to customers after they buy.



This is a writing AND design role. You write the content yourself, based on real research, and you lay it out in Canva so it looks like a premium brand made it, not a template.



What you will be making:



- Lead-magnet ebooks of 15 to 30 pages, for example "Why you look pregnant the week before your period (and what actually helps)" or "The 7-day anti-bloat plan for your cycle".

- Short guides and checklists (3 to 8 pages) that go out by
 after purchase: how to take the capsules, what to eat that week, a cycle tracker.

- Carousel versions of the same content for Instagram and TikTok (5 to 8 slides).

- Occasional blog articles based on the ebook research.



What the content must be:



- Researched. You read studies, Reddit threads, TikTok comments and Amazon reviews and you quote real sources. No made-up statistics.

- Written in the reader's own words. She is 22 to 45, she says "I feel like a balloon" and "my jeans don't close", not "abdominal distension". Plain, warm, human sentences. If it reads like ChatGPT wrote it, it goes back.

- Correct on claims. We are a food supplement in the EU, so no "cures", "treats" or medical promises. I'll give you a one-page claims guide.

- Beautifully designed. Clean serif headlines, lots of white space, cream and forest green, real-looking photos (we supply) or simple illustrations. Think Arrae, Semaine, Aesop. Not pink, not cartoonish, not a stock-template look.

- In English first. We translate to Dutch ourselves, unless you also write Dutch (a big plus, not required).



Tools you must be good with:



- Canva Pro at an advanced level: master pages, brand kits, custom fonts, export to PDF and PNG.

- Google Docs for drafts, Notion for the content plan.

- ChatGPT or Claude is fine for research and first drafts, but you must rewrite everything in a human voice and check every fact.

- Nice to have: Figma, basic Photoshop, experience with women's health or wellness brands.



What I expect from you:



- You can take a topic and a short brief and come back with a finished, designed ebook without me explaining every step.

- You have taste. You know the difference between a PDF that looks "fine" and one that looks like a brand with a big budget made it.

- You give honest input and suggest better topics and angles.

- You keep to deadlines and send a short update without me chasing you.



How we work:



- Start with a small paid test project: one 10-page guide, researched, written and designed. If it's good, we continue with 2 to 4 pieces per month, long term.

- Flexible hours, but reachable on weekdays in the Netherlands daytime (CET).

- Communication via WhatsApp or Slack, files via Google Drive.

- I run several brands, so there is steady work for the right person.



How to apply:



Send me 2 or 3 ebooks or guides you wrote AND designed yourself (PDF or Canva link). Tell me which part was yours. Also send one paragraph (max 100 words) explaining, in plain language, why a woman bloats before her period. I want to see how you write.



Applications without examples will not be read.



To make sure you've read this whole post, start your application with the word OLIVE. Applications that don't start with that word will be ignored.

title: B2B Appointment Setter & Cold Caller – US Market
description:
Grit Systems is a growing US-focused digital services company helping contractors and home service businesses grow through professional websites, CRM systems, automated follow-ups and lead management.



We work with plumbers, roofers, HVAC companies, electricians and other service businesses across the United States.



We are looking for an experienced, confident and highly motivated B2B Appointment Setter and Cold Caller to join our team.



This is a full-time position with a competitive base salary, performance bonuses and long-term growth opportunities.



We want someone who is comfortable speaking with American business owners, has excellent spoken and written English, and knows how to turn conversations into qualified sales appointments.



Your Responsibilities



Cold Calling & Appointment Setting

- Make approximately 50–100 outbound calls per day to US business owners, alongside managing incoming enquiries.

- Contact contractors and introduce our website and business automation services.

- Build rapport, handle objections and generate genuine interest.

- Qualify interested business owners and book appointments directly into our sales calendar.

- Follow up with prospects who request additional information.

- Maintain accurate records of conversations and appointments.



WhatsApp &
 Communication

- Manage outgoing and incoming WhatsApp conversations.

- Respond promptly and professionally to interested prospects.

- Manage
 enquiries and follow-up conversations.

- Share examples of our websites and services with potential customers.

- Work alongside our automated WhatsApp and
 outreach systems.

- Keep conversations natural, professional and focused on booking appointments.



GoHighLevel CRM Management

- Work daily inside GoHighLevel.

- Manage contacts, conversations, pipelines and appointments.

- Update lead statuses and maintain accurate records.

- Track follow-ups and ensure interested prospects are not overlooked.

- Coordinate appointments and provide relevant information to our sales closer.



What We Are Looking For



- Previous B2B appointment-setting and cold-calling experience is essential.

- Experience calling US businesses, preferably contractors or home service companies.

- Excellent spoken English with clear, natural pronunciation.

- Confident, friendly and persuasive telephone communication.

- Strong written English for WhatsApp and
 conversations.

- Experience using GoHighLevel or similar CRM software.

- Ability to handle objections and communicate confidently with business owners.

- Self-motivated, organised and comfortable working independently.

- Reliable internet connection, professional headset and quiet working environment.

- Willingness to work US business hours.



Experience selling websites, digital marketing, SaaS or business services is a significant advantage.



Salary & Performance Bonuses



Base Salary: $1,000 USD per month



Additional performance bonuses:



- $10 for every qualified sales appointment booked that is attended.

- $25 for every new paying customer generated from your appointments.



A qualified appointment means a genuine business owner or decision-maker who has expressed interest in our services and attends the scheduled sales meeting.



There is no fixed limit on the number of performance bonuses you can earn.



We provide the CRM system, lead lists, outreach tools, service information and sales materials.



Your primary responsibility is to generate qualified appointments. Our sales closer handles the final sales presentation and closing.



Mandatory Loom Video Application



To be considered, you must submit a short Loom video lasting approximately 60–90 seconds.



This allows us to assess your communication skills, confidence, English pronunciation and suitability for speaking with American business owners.



Part 1: Introduce Yourself



Briefly introduce yourself and explain your previous experience with B2B cold calling, appointment setting and US clients.



Part 2: Cold Call Demonstration



Imagine you are calling the owner of a plumbing company in Charlotte, North Carolina.



Please deliver the following introduction naturally, as though you are speaking to a real business owner:



"Hi, this is John calling from Grit Systems. I came across your plumbing business in Charlotte, North Carolina, and I was having a look at your website. I noticed it could do with a bit of an update.



We actually build modern websites specifically for contractors, and I'd love to show you a few examples of what we've done.



Would you be open to having a quick look?"



Part 3: Handling an Objection



Imagine the business owner replies:



"I'm busy at the moment. I'm not really interested."



Demonstrate how you would respond professionally and naturally.



Please speak conversationally rather than simply reading from a script.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your previous B2B cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.

title: Social Media Content Creator - AI Images, Realistic Graphics & Metricool
description:
Grit Systems is a growing US-focused digital services company providing professional websites, CRM systems, lead generation tools and business automation services to American contractors.



We work with plumbers, roofers, electricians, HVAC companies and other home service businesses across the United States.



We are looking for a talented social media content creator to produce and schedule four months of professional social media content for our business.



This is a fixed-price project with the possibility of additional work in the future.



Project Overview



We require 120 high-quality social media posts, covering November 2026 through February 2027.



The content will be published across two Grit Systems social media accounts, with one post per day.



We want the content created, written, organised and scheduled in Metricool so that the entire campaign runs automatically.



The successful applicant will be responsible for completing the entire project from content creation through final scheduling.



Content Requirements



- Create 120 professional social media posts with engaging captions.

- Adapt and schedule the content across two social media accounts, approximately 240 scheduled publications in total.

- Use realistic photography, high-quality stock images and photorealistic AI-generated images.

- Create content relevant to American contractors and home service businesses.

- Feature professional website designs, lead generation, CRM systems and business automation.

- Showcase examples of websites we have built using actual screenshots provided by our company.

- Promote our website and CRM services, including our $295/month package.

- Create educational posts, promotional content, business tips and service highlights.

- Maintain consistent Grit Systems branding throughout.

- Include appropriate calls to action and relevant hashtags where suitable.



Important: Content Style



We want modern, realistic, premium-looking social media content.



We do not want cartoon illustrations, generic motivational graphics, cheap-looking templates or obviously artificial AI images.



Our preference is for realistic images of contractors working, genuine-looking business environments, modern website screenshots and professional advertising-style content.



You may use AI tools such as ChatGPT, AI image generators, licensed stock photography or professional graphic design software to produce the content.



Canva is optional. We are more interested in the quality of the finished content than which software you use.



All third-party images must be appropriately licensed for commercial use.



Metricool Scheduling



You must have experience using Metricool or be confident working with its content scheduling and bulk-upload features.



Your responsibilities include:



- Prepare all graphics and captions.

- Organise content into a structured posting calendar.

- Upload and schedule content directly in Metricool.

- Schedule daily posts across both social accounts for the agreed campaign period.

- Check that images, captions, links and publishing dates are correct.

- Provide all completed content files and editable source designs.

- Confirm that the posts have been correctly scheduled.



The objective is to have our social media accounts publishing automatically without requiring daily manual work from us.



Project Timeline



The project must be completed within 10 working days.



We will provide our website, logo, branding information, service details and examples of our contractor website designs.



The process will be:



1. Create the first 10 social media posts for approval.

2. Make any necessary adjustments based on our feedback.

3. Complete the remaining content using the approved style.

4. Begin scheduling approved posts while production continues.

5. Complete the full content library and Metricool scheduling.

6. Deliver all content files and confirm the scheduled publishing calendar.



Posts scheduled after approval should cover the remaining campaign dates through February 28, 2027. The complete content library must contain 120 posts.



Required Skills



- Experience creating professional social media content for businesses.

- Strong ability to generate realistic AI images and source professional stock photography.

- Excellent written English, particularly for American business audiences.

- Experience with social media scheduling tools, preferably Metricool.

- Good understanding of branding, visual design and content marketing.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Attention to detail and consistent design quality.



Experience creating content for digital marketing agencies, SaaS companies or US service businesses is an advantage.



Payment



Fixed Project Budget: $400 USD



This payment covers the creation of 120 posts, captions, graphics, content organisation, adaptation across two social accounts and complete Metricool scheduling.



We are looking for someone who works efficiently using modern AI-assisted content creation tools.



There may be further content projects available after successful completion.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. What experience do you have creating professional social media content?

2. Which AI image generation and editing tools do you use?

3. Have you used Metricool to schedule social media posts?

4. Can you share examples of realistic, professional social media graphics you have created?

5. Have you previously created content for US businesses?

6. Can you complete 120 posts, captions and scheduling within 10 working days for $400?

7. Are you available to start immediately?



Please include a link to your portfolio or examples of previous work.



Applications with professional, realistic content examples will receive priority.



We are ready to hire immediately.

- Find the strongest frame in the footage: the face mid-yell, the moment of the shove, the reaction.



- Clean up stills from low-quality phone video: upscale, sharpen, fix the colour and light, and cut people out when the design needs it.



- Add short, bold text, usually 1–3 words, that adds to the title instead of repeating it.



- Deliver 2–3 versions of each thumbnail so we can test them against each other with YouTube's Test & Compare.



- Check every thumbnail at phone size before you send it.



- Save the layered source file (PSD or similar) next to each export in our shared Google Drive.



- Follow each channel's style guide, and suggest changes when a thumbnail underperforms.



THE STYLE FOR OUR FIRST CHANNEL



- One real frame from the clip, with the person's face large and mid-expression.



- The image enhanced so it looks sharp and bright, without looking fake.



- 1–3 words in a heavy font, bright yellow with a black outline, such as "FIRED!" or "WHAT HAPPENED?", sometimes with a smaller "*UPDATE*" underneath.



- Text on one side and the face on the other. No emojis, borders or clutter: the face does the work.



Every thumbnail must show what really happened in the footage and follow YouTube's thumbnail policies: no blood or graphic injuries, no made-up quotes, and children's faces blurred.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- A portfolio of YouTube thumbnails you designed, ideally for commentary, news, true crime, drama or reaction channels.



- Strong Photoshop skills (or similar): cutouts, colour grading, text effects and rescuing blurry frames from phone video.



- An eye for what gets clicks. You study what's working in a niche and can explain why a thumbnail works.



- The ability to keep up volume without the quality dropping.



- Good written English, so the words on a thumbnail are short and correct.



- Comfort working with heated footage, some of it offensive.



- Reliable deadlines and clear communication.



- Bonus: experience with YouTube's Test & Compare or with AI upscaling tools.



Workload: To start, 3–5 videos a week, each with 2–3 thumbnail versions. This will grow as we add channels.



Turnaround: Within 24 hours of receiving the title and footage.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "guava" and include:



1. Your
 address



2. Your portfolio link (Behance, Google Drive or similar, set so anyone with the link can view)



3. Links to 3–5 YouTube videos that use thumbnails you designed (link the videos, not image files), and the channel each one is for



4. The YouTube channels you've designed thumbnails for, when, and how many thumbnails a week you made for each (or "none yet")



5. Your current workload: how many thumbnails you design in a typical week, for how many clients, and how many more a week you could take on for us



6. A thumbnail idea for this story: a man in a new pickup truck sprays a 17-year-old car wash attendant with a pressure washer over $2, and his company fires him. Describe the frame you'd use and the text you'd put on it, in 2–3 sentences



7. The software you use, including anything for upscaling or cleaning up blurry video frames



8. Your expected rate (per thumbnail or per month)



9. How quickly you usually deliver a thumbnail after receiving a brief, and the hours you work (Philippine time)



10. Your 
 username



Applications that skip the code word or any of items 1–9 won't be reviewed.

title: Architect ALUMINUM Estimator
description:
## Architectural Estimator / Project Estimator



**AluGlobus Aluminum Systems** is a growing U.S.-based manufacturer and supplier of aluminum fencing, gates, patio covers, pergola systems, railings, and architectural aluminum products.



We are looking for a **skilled, organized, and detail-oriented Architectural Estimator** to join our team and prepare customer quotes on a daily basis.



This is not just a data-entry position. We need someone who can understand a project, review measurements, photos, drawings, and customer requests, determine what materials are needed, and build an accurate professional quote.



### Responsibilities



- Prepare detailed estimates and customer quotes every day

- Review architectural drawings, plans, measurements, photos, and project information

- Break down fence, gate, railing, patio cover, and pergola projects into the materials and components required

- Calculate quantities, dimensions, and project requirements accurately

- Use Photoshop or similar software to make basic photo edits, markups, and project visualizations

- Communicate with customers by phone when additional measurements, photos, or project information are needed

- Work with our sales team to clarify project requirements

- Keep quotes, drawings, customer information, and project files highly organized

- Double-check estimates before they are sent to customers

- Learn our aluminum systems, profiles, accessories, pricing, and installation requirements

- Handle multiple quotes and projects at the same time while meeting deadlines



### Who We Are Looking For



You should be **very detail-oriented and organized**. Small mistakes in dimensions or materials can affect an entire project, so accuracy is extremely important.



Preferred experience:



- Architecture, estimating, construction, engineering, drafting, or similar background

- Experience reading construction plans and architectural drawings

- Experience preparing material takeoffs or project estimates

- Good understanding of measurements and dimensions

- Photoshop skills

- AutoCAD, SketchUp, or similar design software is a strong advantage

- Strong written and spoken English

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone

- Strong computer skills

- Ability to learn new products and systems quickly

- Ability to work independently and solve problems

- Excellent attention to detail



Experience with **fencing, gates, aluminum systems, patio covers, pergolas, railings, construction, or exterior architectural products** is a major advantage.



### What Success Looks Like



You can receive a project with photos, dimensions, drawings, or plans and understand what the customer is trying to build.



You know what information is missing and are comfortable contacting the customer to get it.



You can then break the project down, calculate the required materials, and prepare a **clean, accurate, professional quote** for our sales team and customer.



We are a fast-growing company with a high volume of projects, so we are looking for someone who wants a **long-term position and an opportunity to grow with the company.**



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. A short introduction about your estimating, architecture, or construction experience

3. Software you know how to use

4. Examples of drawings, estimates, takeoffs, designs, or projects you have worked on

5. A short video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for this position

 & SMS Marketing

 flows.

, Loox.

## What We Expect From You



We want someone who is **proactive, analytical, experienced, and obsessed with improving eCommerce performance.**



You should be able to:



- Audit a Shopify store and immediately identify potential revenue leaks.

- Create a clear action plan to increase revenue and profitability.

- Independently implement improvements without constant instructions.

- Understand which changes will have the biggest financial impact.

- Prioritize high-impact improvements over unnecessary tasks.

- Build and manage a complete abandoned cart recovery system.

- Create and optimize offers, bundles, and upsells.

- Continuously test new strategies.

- Monitor performance and report measurable results.

- Take full ownership of store conversion and revenue optimization.

- Work across multiple Shopify stores when needed.

- Think like an eCommerce growth manager, not just a Shopify assistant.



## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Your performance will be evaluated based on improvements in:



- Conversion rate (CVR)

- Average order value (AOV)

- Revenue per visitor (RPV)

- Revenue and contribution profit

- Upsell and cross-sell revenue

- Abandoned checkout recovery rate

-
 and SMS attributed revenue

- Repeat customer purchase rate

- Customer lifetime value (LTV)

- Checkout completion rate

- Add-to-cart rate

- Overall store profitability



## Who We Are Looking For



**Required:**

- Proven experience scaling and optimizing Shopify stores.

- Strong experience with CRO, AOV optimization, and offer creation.

- Experience building abandoned cart and
 recovery automations.

- Ability to work independently and execute improvements.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Understanding of eCommerce profitability.

- Experience using Shopify apps and optimization tools.

- Excellent communication skills.

- Results-driven mindset.



**Big Plus:**

- Experience with direct-response eCommerce.

- Experience with paid traffic funnels (Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads).

- Experience with subscription-based eCommerce.

- Experience managing multiple international Shopify stores.

- Experience with Shopify Liquid or development.

## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:

**If you know how to turn Shopify traffic into more customers, larger orders, and repeat purchases, we want to hear from you.**

We're looking for an experienced B2B cold-calling specialist who knows how to turn complete strangers into genuine sales opportunities.



This is a pure outbound lead generation role. Your job is to find opportunities and book qualified appointments — our Australian sales team handles the selling and closing.

Building rapport, asking great questions and uncovering business pain points.



Handling objections and turning conversations into qualified sales appointments.



Following up with prospects and keeping accurate CRM records.

60% Cold Calling – Prospecting businesses and generating new opportunities.

10% Supplied Leads – Following up on leads provided by QPC Group.
