title: Online Business Manager (OBM) – Operations & Growth | U.S. Life Insurance Agency
description:
Full-Time | Remote — Philippines | $1,200–$1,500 USD/month (depending on experience and demonstrated capabilities)





Are you the kind of person who sees what needs to be done—and makes it happen?



We're looking for an experienced, proactive, and highly resourceful Online Business Manager (OBM) to become the right hand to the founder of a growing U.S.-based life insurance agency.



This is NOT a traditional Virtual Assistant position.



We're not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions, checks tasks off a list, or needs to be told what to do next.



We're looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, takes initiative, solves problems, builds systems, and knows how to turn ideas into completed projects.



Someone who doesn't just identify problems but comes prepared with solutions.



Someone who genuinely wants to understand the business, become invested in its success, and play an important role in helping it grow.



If you're someone who enjoys creating order out of chaos, building processes, improving operations, and making life easier for a busy entrepreneur, we'd love to hear from you.

__________________







*ABOUT US*



Overflow Life & Legacy is a growing U.S.-based independent life insurance agency affiliated with Symmetry Financial Group.



We help families protect what matters most while building an expanding organization of insurance professionals and agency leaders.



Our agency is entering an important season of growth. We're expanding our recruiting efforts, developing new agents, strengthening our systems, and putting the infrastructure in place to support a much larger organization.



We've reached a point where the founder needs more than administrative assistance.



We need an experienced operational partner who can help turn vision into execution.



You'll work directly with the agency owner, helping manage the day-to-day operations while building systems that allow the business to grow more efficiently.



This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact—not simply maintain existing processes.

__________________





*WHAT YOU'LL OWN*



1. Business Operations & Executive Support



Become the founder's right hand in keeping the business organized, efficient, and moving forward.



You'll manage
 inboxes, coordinate communications and follow-ups, organize priorities, oversee administrative workflows, and make sure important responsibilities don't fall through the cracks.



Your job is to help the founder stay focused on the highest-value activities while ensuring day-to-day operations run smoothly.





2. Project Management & Implementation



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



The founder frequently develops new ideas, strategies, and initiatives to improve and grow the agency.



We need someone who can take those ideas, ask the right questions, develop an implementation plan, and drive projects through completion.



You'll establish timelines, organize tasks, manage deadlines, coordinate resources, and take responsibility for execution.



We don't want someone who simply tracks projects. We want someone who makes sure projects get finished.





3. Systems, Processes & Automation



You'll identify inefficiencies, streamline workflows, create SOPs, organize business systems, and implement improvements that help us operate more effectively.



We're looking for someone who enjoys evaluating how things currently work and finding ways to make them better.



You'll work with tools such as Notion, Google Workspace, CRM platforms, spreadsheets, and automation tools.



You don't need to know every platform we use, but you should be highly comfortable learning new systems and figuring out how to make them work together.





4. Recruiting & Agent Onboarding Operations



Recruiting and developing insurance agents is a major part of our growth strategy.



You'll help oversee the operational side of our recruiting pipeline, including candidate tracking, interview coordination, follow-up systems, licensing progress, onboarding, and new agent activation.



You'll also identify bottlenecks, improve processes, coordinate with recruiting partners, and help create systems that support a growing team.



You won't be responsible for personally conducting every interview or training agents to sell insurance. Your responsibility is to help ensure the operational systems supporting those activities are effective.





5. Business Reporting & Performance Dashboards



You'll create and maintain dashboards that give us visibility into recruiting, onboarding, agency performance, and other important business metrics.



But we don't just want someone who enters numbers into spreadsheets.



We want someone who can look at the information, recognize patterns, identify problems, and recommend improvements.





6. Marketing & Growth Coordination



You'll help coordinate marketing initiatives, content schedules, recruiting campaigns, and other growth-related projects.



This includes organizing deliverables, managing timelines, coordinating resources, and ensuring initiatives move from planning to execution.



You don't need to be a graphic designer, video editor, or marketing specialist. You do need to know how to organize and manage marketing projects successfully.

__________________







*WHAT OWNERSHIP LOOKS LIKE*



Let's say the founder shares an idea:



"We need a better onboarding process so new agents can get started faster and begin producing sooner."



A traditional assistant might wait for instructions on exactly what to do.



You would approach it differently.



You'd review the existing process, identify where agents are getting stuck, research potential improvements, and develop a proposed solution.



After discussing the plan with the founder, you'd take ownership of implementation, establish the necessary workflows, coordinate the moving parts, and monitor the results.



And once the project is completed, you'd look for ways to make it even better.



That's the mindset we're looking for.



You'll have the freedom to recommend improvements and make appropriate day-to-day operational decisions within agreed guidelines. Major strategic, financial, and business decisions will remain with the founder.

__________________







*WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR*



We're looking for someone with proven experience managing business operations and independently executing projects, ideally while working directly with an entrepreneur or business owner.



Required Qualifications:



-> 3–5+ years of relevant experience in online business management, operations management, or project management.



-> Demonstrated success taking projects from concept through implementation.



-> Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.



-> Experience developing systems, workflows, and SOPs.



-> Excellent organizational and project management skills.



-> Strong written and spoken English communication.



-> Experience managing competing priorities without constant supervision.



-> Confidence working with spreadsheets, CRMs, project management systems, and other online business tools.



-> The ability to understand how different parts of a business work together.



-> Comfort working in a growing business where not every process has already been documented.



-> Bonus Qualifications:



-> Experience working directly with U.S.-based business owners.



-> Experience managing operations in sales, recruiting, or service-based businesses.



-> Familiarity with Notion, GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, and automation platforms.



-> Experience coordinating marketing initiatives or remote team members.



-> Experience creating and improving business reporting dashboards.



Previous life insurance experience is not required. We're far more interested in your operational capabilities, business judgment, and willingness to learn.

title: Operations & Administration VA | Electrical Trades, SOP Building

Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with strong, verifiable operations or EA experience, ideally from a trades or construction business, and demonstrable SOP-building skills will be prioritised for this role.



An electrical business needs a self-directed, operations-first VA to take ownership of business administration, job management and SOP documentation. The role is operations and administration-led, not marketing-led — social media and website work remain part of the role, but at a scheduling and execution level, with content strategy handled by an external specialist. This is a strong, self-directed operator role: both directors want someone who takes a task, owns it completely, and delivers without needing to be followed up — someone who pushes back, asks good questions, and suggests a better way when they see one.



The role starts at 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday to Friday), with the expectation this grows to full-time reasonably quickly as more tasks are handed over. A broader goal is a fully documented, less founder-dependent business that could run — or be sold — without day-to-day founder involvement by the end of 2027.



What You’ll Own



Operations, Administration & SOP-Building (Primary Focus)



General business administration support: assisting with quotes, invoicing for jobs, and timesheet administration in preparation for payroll

Contribute to building a fully documented, less founder-dependent business

Build out SOPs directly in Asana as processes are established, breaking each task down with the responsible person, day, and expected duration



Job Management (Katipolt)



Manage the back end of the job management platform: job cards, materials uploads, scheduling support, and related workflow

Draft invoices on job completion for maintenance and smaller jobs

Support quoting in the platform

Assist with materials coordination, including checking supplier deliveries and confirming gear is ready for upcoming jobs



Process Documentation



Document new workflows and processes as they’re refined and established — building the SOP library directly off live processes

Store and link all SOPs in Asana, accessible via the mobile app so field-based staff can reference them

Set a quarterly SOP review cadence to keep documentation accurate as the business evolves



 & Customer Communication



Monitor the inbox for customer replies to the business’s automated follow-up sequence, respond where appropriate, and close the loop in the system

Support customer communication throughout the job lifecycle, from initial enquiry through to job completion and follow-up

Manage customer comms within the job platform where possible



Social Media & Website (Scheduling-Level, Not Strategist-Level)



Receive approved content and manage scheduling and light repurposing (e.g. turning a video into a carousel or still-image post) across Instagram,
 and 
 using Meta Business Suite

Update and maintain the WordPress website with minor copy and photo changes as directed — no major redesign or SEO landing-page work required



Business Development & Lead Pipeline



Build and manage a lead pipeline in Asana, moving prospects through stages from initial enquiry to converted client

Manage and improve the quote follow-up process, ensuring no opportunities go cold without contact

Develop and document customer journey touchpoints: enquiry, quote, job commencement, completion, and follow-up/review request

Support outreach and marketing materials as directed



Task & Communication Management



Send a morning WhatsApp message each day with planned priorities

Send an end-of-day
 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and items requiring attention or approval

Manage the Asana task board across daily, weekly and monthly cadences

Record training calls and use the recordings, plus AI tools, to generate SOP drafts

Participate in regular video calls, including impromptu calls while a director is on the road



What We’re Looking For



Experience



Strong general business administration or EA background, with trades or construction industry exposure strongly preferred

Experience with business process documentation or SOP creation, ideally including breaking tasks into responsibility, cadence and time-per-task

Experience with job management, CRM or trades platforms (Simpro, ServiceM8, Tradify or WunderBuild experience is highly transferable)

title: Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Thursday - Monday 11 PM - 9 AM CST | Thursday - Monday 8 PM - 6 AM CST

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

Who Thrives Here

description:

About Golf Event Stays



Golf Event Stays is a growing international property accommodation business specialising in private and luxury property rentals for major golf tournaments, including the Ryder Cup and The Open Championship.



We are looking for a highly intelligent, commercially minded and experienced sales professional who can confidently turn inbound customer enquiries into paying customers.

You will communicate with property owners primarily through WhatsApp and

title: Financial Research & Organic Growth Analyst
description:
Job Title: Financial Research & Organic Growth Analyst



Type: Full-time · Remote · ~35-40 hours/week



Compensation: $605 –$735 USD/month (based on experience and skills)



About PyQuant

PyQuant is a financial research platform that helps individual investors evaluate public companies through fundamental financial analysis and financial statement breakdown. We focus on reported financials, long-term trends, and clear, explainable metric. No market hype or pricing involved.



We're looking for a detail-oriented researcher who understands company financials and can turn that research into useful, engaging content for retail investors, organically growing our audience.



The Role

This is a finance-first research and content role - not a social media scheduling or marketing analytics position. You will:



- Investigate public companies and verify financial claims against primary sources (yahoo finance, reuters, morning star, google finance, bloomberg, etc.)

- Turn your findings into accessible content for retail investors

- Help identify investor communities, creators, and organic channels to reach people interested in fundamental investing



What We're Looking For

1. Financial Statement Analysis:

- Comfortable reading income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements

- Able to interpret revenue growth, profit margins, earnings, debt, liquidity, cash generation, and valuation metrics

- Has identified financial statement trends YoY and QoQ using Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)

- Can identify meaningful multi-year financial trends and explain why a metric matters (and its limitations)



2. SEC Filing Research

- Experience researching companies via 10-Ks, 10-Qs, earnings releases, and investor relations materials

- Able to locate and verify figures against original sources

- Understands reporting periods, accounting terminology, and accurate citations



3. Financial Writing & Content Development

- Strong written English; can explain complex financial concepts clearly to a retail audience

- Can turn research into company breakdowns, metric explainers, comparisons, social posts, and article outlines

- Distinguishes reported facts from interpretation and opinion



4. Organic Marketing & Audience Research

- Interested in value/fundamental investing and the retail investor community

- Can research relevant forums, newsletters, creators, and content platforms (Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads)

- Able to track engagement, referral traffic, and signups where measurable



Preferred Background

Especially value candidates with education/experience in:

- Finance, accounting, equity research, or investment research

- Financial journalism or writing about public companies

- Financial modeling, spreadsheet analysis, or company valuation

- SEO, content strategy, or social media marketing

- Experience with SEC EDGAR, spreadsheets, Canva, and scheduling tools is a plus, but financial research ability and writing quality matter more than any specific tool.



How to Apply

Please include:

- A brief introduction with your relevant experience and resume

- Your background in finance, accounting, research, or writing

- A writing sample (and an example of financial analysis, if available)

- A short explanation of how you'd research a public company using its latest annual report



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid financial research and writing exercise.
